form.label: Coverage
form.description: What the feed can and cannot say anything about. Read this before trusting a low finding count.

div.b: A low finding count is not the same as a secure fleet.

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | stats dc(name) AS components BY type | sort - components | head 40

viz.option: No inventory has been received. Nothing can be assessed until swinv data reaches the index.

div.span: Click an ecosystem above to narrow everything below it to that ecosystem.

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | search $eco_filter$ | eval has_identifier = if((isnotnull(purl) AND purl!="") OR (isnotnull(cpe_list) AND cpe_list!=""), 1, 0) | stats count AS components, sum(has_identifier) AS with_identifier BY type | eval without_identifier = components - with_identifier | eval identifier_pct = round(with_identifier * 100 / components, 1) | sort - components | rename type AS "Ecosystem", components AS "Components", with_identifier AS "With purl/cpe", without_identifier AS "No identifier", identifier_pct AS "Identifiable %"

viz.option: No inventory has been received yet.

search.query: | `riskability_open_findings` | search ecosystem=$eco_name|s$ | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | stats dc(package) AS packages, dc(cve_id) AS cves BY root, hostname | sort - packages | rename root AS "Root", hostname AS "Host", packages AS "Packages", cves AS "CVEs"

viz.option: No inventory has been received yet.

panel.title: Ecosystems present in the fleet but absent from the feed

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | search $eco_filter$ | eval cpe_ident = if(isnotnull(cpe_list) AND cpe_list!="", 1, 0) | stats count AS components, sum(cpe_ident) AS cpe_ident BY type | append [| `riskability_feed_ecosystems` | rename ecosystem AS type] | eventstats max(eval(if(type=="cpe", feed_ranges, null()))) AS cpe_ranges | stats max(components) AS components, max(cpe_ident) AS cpe_ident, max(feed_packages) AS feed_packages, max(feed_ranges) AS feed_ranges, max(cpe_ranges) AS cpe_ranges BY type | where isnotnull(components) | eval feed_packages = coalesce(feed_packages, 0), feed_ranges = coalesce(feed_ranges, 0) | eval status = case( feed_ranges > 0, "covered", cpe_ident > 0 AND cpe_ranges > 0, "covered through CPE", type IN ("linux-kernel-module","linux-kernel","github-action","github-action-workflow","binary","hotfix"), "no feed exists for this type", 1=1, "add this ecosystem to the bundle") | eval reach = case(feed_ranges > 0, tostring(feed_ranges, "commas"), cpe_ident > 0 AND cpe_ranges > 0, tostring(cpe_ranges, "commas") . " CPE ranges", 1=1, "0") | eval feed_packages = if(feed_packages < 0, "counted approximately", tostring(feed_packages, "commas")) | sort - components | rename type AS "Ecosystem", components AS "Components in fleet", feed_packages AS "Packages in feed", reach AS "Version ranges reachable", status AS "Status" | fields "Ecosystem", "Components in fleet", "Packages in feed", "Version ranges reachable", "Status"

viz.option: Every ecosystem in the fleet is covered by the imported feed. This is the one empty table here that is genuinely good news.
